mapper.select: SELECT s.settlement_id AS settlementId, s.settlement_no AS settlementNo, s.author_id AS authorId, u.nick_name AS authorName, u.phonenumber AS authorPhone, DATE_FORMAT(s.period_start, '%Y-%m-%d') AS periodStart, DATE_FORMAT(s.period_end, '%Y-%m-%d') AS periodEnd, s.order_count AS orderCount, s.total_amount AS totalAmount, s.platform_amount AS platformAmount, s.author_amount AS authorAmount, s.platform_ratio AS platformRatio, s.status, DATE_FORMAT(s.settlement_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS settlementTime, s.abnormal_reason AS abnormalReason, s.handle_remark AS handleRemark, s.remark, DATE_FORMAT(s.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS createTime FROM sys_settlement s LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON s.author_id = u.user_id WHERE s.settlement_id = #{settlementId}

SELECT o.order_no AS orderNo, w.title AS workName, o.total_amount AS amount, o.seller_amount AS authorIncome, DATE_FORMAT(o.pay_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') AS orderTime FROM sys_order o LEFT JOIN sys_work w ON o.work_id = w.work_id LEFT JOIN sys_settlement s ON s.settlement_id = #{settlementId} WHERE o.seller_id = s.author_id AND o.status = 'completed' AND o.pay_time BETWEEN s.period_start AND DATE_ADD(s.period_end, INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY o.pay_time DESC
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO sys_settlement
settlement_no, author_id, period_start, period_end, order_count, total_amount, platform_amount, author_amount, platform_ratio, status, settlement_time, abnormal_reason, create_by, remark, create_time
#{settlementNo}, #{authorId}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{orderCount}, #{totalAmount}, #{platformAmount}, #{authorAmount}, #{platformRatio}, #{status}, #{settlementTime}, #{abnormalReason}, #{createBy}, #{remark}, NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_settlement SET status = 'abnormal', abnormal_reason = #{abnormalReason}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'pending'
UPDATE sys_settlement SET handle_remark = #{handleRemark}, status = 'pending', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = NOW() WHERE settlement_id = #{settlementId} AND status = 'abnormal'
mapper.select: SELECT o.seller_id AS authorId, COUNT(*) AS orderCount, SUM(o.total_amount) AS totalAmount, SUM(o.seller_amount) AS authorAmount FROM sys_order o WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND o.pay_time BETWEEN #{periodStart} AND #{periodEnd} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_settlement s WHERE s.author_id = o.seller_id AND s.period_start = #{periodStart} AND s.period_end = #{periodEnd} ) GROUP BY o.seller_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 0
